bull.point: Net profit rebounded strongly in Q1 FY27 (Rs 493 crore) and Q2 FY27 (Rs 502 crore) with operating margins reaching 36.1-37.9%.
Management raised FY27 ROA guidance to 5.2%-5.8% and ROE guidance to 21%-24% following strong H1 FY27 results.
Borrowing costs decreased by 60 bps in FY26 to 9.2%, expanding NIMs to 15.1% by Q2 FY27.

bear.point: FY25 earnings fell steeply, with PAT dropping 63.3% YoY to Rs 531 crore and ROA dropping to 1.9%.
Elevated portfolio write-offs of 7.6% in FY26 pushed annual credit costs to 6.74%, above initial guidance.
PAR accretion risks persist from flood disruptions in Aug-Sept and frontline employee attrition of 20.6%.

watch.point: Drought impact in Maharashtra districts and PAR accretion trend from recent flooding.
Achievement of full-year FY27 ROA target of 5.2%-5.8% and AUM growth of 20%-25%.
Single-digit borrower growth relative to AUM expansion and frontline staff attrition levels.
